Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

in the last five years. Government servant. - OM, dated 25-2-2009.  
Relaxation.Ministries/ Departments may consider allowing relaxation with the approval of their Minister-in-charge in the following cases-  
- (a) A Central Government employee after completion of 7 years of service may go on deputation to NER, J&K, UT of A&N and Lakshadweep or on foreign service to any entity controlled by or located in the above places.
